description_en: Regenerates an objective model on an ad-hoc basis
kebab_example: aliyun sls regenerate-source-model --project my-project --biz-language zh_cn --logstores order-log --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegenerateSourceModel

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. The model belongs to this project, and each project corresponds to one model
parameters.help_zh: Project 名称。模型归属于该 Project，一个 Project 对应一个模型
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The generation language. Valid values: zh_cn and en_us. Default value: zh_cn. This value is not inherited from the creation request and must be specified each time
parameters.help_zh: 生成语言，取值 zh_cn / en_us，缺省 zh_cn；不继承 create 时的取值，需每次重传
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The list of Logstore names used for modeling. If you omit this parameter or pass an empty array, all Logstores in the project are used for modeling
parameters.help_zh: 参与建模的 Logstore 名称列表。省略或传空数组表示对该 Project 下的全部 Logstore 建模
parameters.name: logstores

schema.description_en: The response body. Indicates that the regeneration request has been accepted
schema.description_zh: 响应体。表示重新生成请求已被受理

status.description_en: The status of the call result. If the request is accepted, success is returned. Regeneration is an asynchronous process. A success response only indicates that the task has been submitted. To check whether the model is ready, call GetSourceModelStatus
status.description_zh: 调用结果状态。受理成功时固定返回 success。重新生成是异步过程，返回 success 仅表示任务已提交，模型就绪请调用 GetSourceModelStatus 确认

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. You can omit this parameter or specify only the scope and language for the current regeneration
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。可省略，也可以只设置本次重新生成的范围与语言
v1_body_parameters.name: body
